levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the five earlier artifacts is missing from the assembled plan.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five artifacts are present and assembled into one plan.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The assembled plan is organized clearly enough to actually be reused, not just a loose collection.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The review date is vague, or no privacy level is stated.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A specific review date and an explicit privacy level are both recorded.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reflection response identifies a realistic, specific reason the plan would actually get revisited, not a generic intention.

lookFors: All five earlier artifacts are represented in the assembled plan.
A specific calendar date, not a vague timeframe, is set for review.
No full name or other identifying detail replaces the role labels used earlier in the unit.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
